question: Does the existing F(E8) boundary with its odd pair component realize the native W, group action, CAR/CCR state space and original time simultaneously?
summary_de: Im vorhandenen F(E8)+I(1,1)-Rand reproduzieren 64 ungerade Strom-mal-Fermion-Felder den vollstaendigen nativen W-Tensor samt beiden Spin10xSU4-Wirkungen. Das lokale Paarprodukt hat Rang60; die korrekte antisymmetrische zweite OPE-Koeffizientenabbildung ist auf allen2016 Paarrichtungen injektiv. Der1956-dimensionale dunkle Raum erscheint zuerst bei Gewicht5 statt3. Das native unabhaengige Fermionpaar und sein Vermittler fallen dagegen auf denselben Quellenzustand zusammen; die Felder erfuellen nicht die nativen CAR. Alle480 urspruenglichen freien Paar-/Vermittlerenergieabstaende sind ungleich0, auch mit Viertelladungsterm; Vaux ist eine gewaehlte andere Energie. Neue Charged-Lift-Lane reproduziert. Physischer Quell-/Zustands-/Zeitlift und Gesamtherleitung bleiben offen.
assumptions: Existing conditional Gamma=I(9,1), F(E8), q,Y and g markings
Native FW,BW,W and full product group reconstructed from the original source
Selected massless Vaux only for chiral currents and OPE jets; V0 retained for actual free-energy comparison
Standard lattice vertex algebra and inherited physical parity
kills: Identify equality of W and internal group representations with a derived canonical 64-CAR/60-CCR Hamiltonian.
Treat the coincident composite mediator and its own fermion-pair product as two independent source states.
Use ordered bilocal products as an equivariant exterior-square map without antisymmetrizing field labels.
Treat the selected Vaux energy as a passive version of the original free V0 energy.
Use a global quarter-charge shift to remove the derived pair-energy offsets.
Transfer the native Fock vacuum theorem through the rank-deficient coincident field map.

Source selection of the ten channels and actual interacting energy
Physical native CAR/CCR realization or rederived composite-field dynamics
Gauge dynamics, source hypercharge lift, vacuum, flavor masses and 3+1D/gravity bridge

The E8 current tensor or native W itself as a new discovery
A full Fock algebra from the finite exterior-square jet injection
Independent agent review, formal proof-assistant verification or any physical gate closure
